words.cn: vi. 由…组成; 在于
words.example: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.exampleCn: 水由氢和氧组成。

words.cn: n. 建设, 建筑物
words.example: The new bridge is a huge construction project.
words.exampleCn: 这座新桥是一项巨大的建设工程。

words.cn: vt. 咨询, 请教, 查阅 vi. (with) 商量, 商议
words.example: You should consult a doctor about your cough.
words.exampleCn: 你应该找医生看看你的咳嗽。

words.cn: vt. 消耗, 消费, 吃, 喝
words.example: Cars consume a lot of fuel every day.
words.exampleCn: 汽车每天消耗大量燃料。

words.cn: vt. 包含, 容纳
words.example: This box contains all the books I need.
words.exampleCn: 这个盒子里装着我需要的所有书。

words.cn: n. 容器; 集装箱
words.example: The ship carried hundreds of containers.
words.exampleCn: 这艘船装了几百个集装箱。

words.cn: n. 内容; a. 满足的, 满意的
words.example: The content of the book is interesting.
words.exampleCn: 这本书的内容很有趣。

words.cn: n. 大陆, 洲
words.example: Africa is a hot continent.
words.exampleCn: 非洲是一个炎热的大陆。

words.cn: a. (to) 相反的 n. [the~] 相反, 对立面
words.example: On the contrary, I think you are right.
words.exampleCn: 相反,我认为你是对的。

words.cn: v. (to) 贡献, 捐献, 有助于, 促成
words.example: Everyone can contribute to protecting the environment.
words.exampleCn: 每个人都可以为保护环境出力。

words.cn: vt. 确信, 使信服, 说服
words.example: She convinced me to take the job.
words.exampleCn: 她说服我接受了那份工作。

words.cn: n. 村舍, 小屋, 小别墅
words.example: They spent the weekend in a small cottage by the lake.
words.exampleCn: 他们在湖边的小屋里度过了周末。

words.cn: vt. 治愈 n. 治愈, 疗法
words.example: The new drug may cure the disease.
words.exampleCn: 这种新药也许能治好这种病。

words.cn: n. (窗、门) 帘
words.example: Please draw the curtain before you sleep.
words.exampleCn: 睡觉前请把窗帘拉上。

words.cn: n. /vt. 毁坏, 损害
words.example: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.exampleCn: 风暴对房子造成了严重损坏。

words.cn: n. /adj. 潮湿 (的)
words.example: The walls are damp after the rain.
words.exampleCn: 雨后墙壁很潮湿。

words.cn: n. 资料, 数据
words.example: We need more data to solve this problem.
words.exampleCn: 我们需要更多数据来解决这个问题。

words.cn: n. 债务
words.example: He paid off his debt in two years.
words.exampleCn: 他两年内还清了债务。

words.cn: vt. 宣布, 声明, 断言
words.example: The president declared a public holiday.
words.exampleCn: 总统宣布了一个公共假日。

words.cn: v. /n. 减少, 减小
words.example: Sales decreased last winter.
words.exampleCn: 去年冬天销售额下降了。

words.cn: n. 防御, 保护, 辩护
words.example: The soldiers are trained for the defense of the country.
words.exampleCn: 士兵们训练保卫国家。

words.cn: n. /v. 延迟, 耽搁, 拖延
words.example: The flight was delayed by two hours.
words.exampleCn: 航班延误了两个小时。

words.cn: n. 快乐, 乐事 v. 使高兴
words.example: The kids shouted with delight at the gift.
words.exampleCn: 孩子们看到礼物高兴得叫了起来。

words.cn: v. /n. 要求, 需要
words.example: The boss demanded an explanation for the mistake.
words.exampleCn: 老板要求对这个错误做出解释。

words.cn: n. (企业/机构的) 部, 局, 处, 科; (大学的) 系
words.example: She works in the sales department of the company.
words.exampleCn: 她在公司的销售部工作。

words.cn: vt. 应受, 值得
words.example: You deserve a rest after all that hard work.
words.exampleCn: 你辛苦了这么久,应该休息一下。

words.cn: v. /n. 渴望, 期望
words.example: She has a strong desire to become a doctor.
words.exampleCn: 她强烈渴望成为一名医生。

words.cn: v. 决定; 下定决心
words.example: I determined to study harder this term.
words.exampleCn: 我下定决心这学期要更努力学习。

words.cn: vt. 致力, 献身, 用于
words.example: She devoted her life to helping poor children.
words.exampleCn: 她一生致力于帮助贫困儿童。

words.cn: vt. 消化, 领会
words.example: Some foods are hard to digest.
words.exampleCn: 有些食物很难消化。

words.cn: n. 不利 (条件), 弱点
words.example: Living alone has both advantages and disadvantages.
words.exampleCn: 独居有利也有弊。

words.cn: vi. 不同意, 不符
words.example: I disagree with your opinion.
words.exampleCn: 我不同意你的观点。

words.cn: n. (about, on) 讨论, 议论
words.example: We had a long discussion about the trip.
words.exampleCn: 我们就这次旅行进行了长时间的讨论。

words.cn: v. 区别, 辨别出, 使杰出
words.example: It's hard to distinguish the twins apart.
words.exampleCn: 这对双胞胎很难分辨。

words.cn: n. 区, 地区, 区域
words.example: We live in a quiet district in the north of the city.
words.exampleCn: 我们住在城市北部一个安静的区。

words.cn: vt. 扰乱, 打扰, 使不安
words.example: Please don't disturb the baby.
words.exampleCn: 请不要吵醒宝宝。

words.cn: n. 一打 (12个), 许多
words.example: She bought a dozen eggs from the shop.
words.exampleCn: 她在商店买了一打鸡蛋。
